name: Hide Copilot Taskbar Button
description: Hides the Copilot button from the Windows 11 taskbar.
whatItDoes: Hides the Copilot button from the Windows taskbar.
sideEffects: Removes the quick-access Copilot taskbar icon.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar items › Copilot
effectNote: Works only on Windows 11 22H2/23H2 with the old Copilot button. On 24H2 and later Copilot is a regular app; unpin it from the taskbar instead.

name: Disable Windows Copilot Globally
description: Turns off the Windows Copilot assistant system-wide using policy.
whatItDoes: Sets the TurnOffWindowsCopilot user policy, which turns off the Copilot sidebar in Windows 11 23H2.
sideEffects: Copilot sidebar and keyboard shortcut (Win+C) become completely disabled.
effectNote: Only disables the old Copilot sidebar on Windows 11 23H2. On 24H2 and later Copilot is an app that this policy does not block; uninstall the Copilot app instead.

name: Disable Windows Recall Snapshots
description: Prevents Windows from saving photographic snapshots of screen activities for Recall.
whatItDoes: Disables Windows Recall automated screen snapshot capture and indexing.
sideEffects: Recall stops saving snapshots and existing snapshots are deleted; the user cannot turn snapshot saving back on while the policy is set.
effectNote: Only has an effect on Copilot+ PCs that have Recall. Snapshots are off by default; this policy keeps them off and deletes existing ones.

name: Disable Bing Web Search in Start Menu
description: Restricts Start menu search to local files, settings, and apps without querying Bing.
whatItDoes: Disables Bing web search suggestions from Start Menu searches.
sideEffects: Search box queries will only index and display local programs and files.

name: Enable Windows Game Mode
description: Prioritizes CPU and GPU resources for active games and suppresses background tasks.
whatItDoes: Enables Windows Game Mode to prioritize CPU and GPU allocation for active games.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Gaming › Game Mode › Game Mode

name: Disable Game Bar Captures and Controller Button
description: Turns off Game Bar game capture and stops the controller Xbox button from opening Game Bar.
whatItDoes: Sets AppCaptureEnabled and UseNexusForGameBarEnabled off, so Game Bar does not record and the controller button does not open it.
sideEffects: Game clips and screenshots through Game Bar stop working. Win+G can still open the Game Bar overlay.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Gaming › Game Bar › Open Xbox Game Bar using this button on a controller

name: Disable Background Game DVR Recording
description: Turns off Game Bar background recording of recent gameplay. It is off by default, so this only matters if it was turned on.
whatItDoes: Sets HistoricalCaptureEnabled off, the same as the 'Record what happened' switch in Settings.
sideEffects: You cannot save a clip of gameplay that already happened. Manual recording still works.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Gaming › Captures › Record in the background while I'm playing a game

name: Disable Mouse Acceleration (Enhance Pointer Precision)
description: Disables non-linear pointer acceleration for 1:1 true raw mouse input in games and desktop.

apply.script:
$m = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'
Add-Type -Namespace WinVelo -Name MouseSpi -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(int uiAction, int uiParam, int[] pvParam, int fWinIni);'
[WinVelo.MouseSpi]::SystemParametersInfo(4, 0, [int[]]([int]$m.MouseThreshold1, [int]$m.MouseThreshold2, [int]$m.MouseSpeed), 3) | Out-Null

undo.script:
$m = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'
Add-Type -Namespace WinVelo -Name MouseSpi -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(int uiAction, int uiParam, int[] pvParam, int fWinIni);'
[WinVelo.MouseSpi]::SystemParametersInfo(4, 0, [int[]]([int]$m.MouseThreshold1, [int]$m.MouseThreshold2, [int]$m.MouseSpeed), 3) | Out-Null

whatItDoes: Disables Windows pointer precision acceleration curve in HKCU, ensuring 1:1 physical-to-virtual mouse cursor movement.
sideEffects: Mouse cursor movement speed will feel different and will not accelerate when moving the mouse quickly across high-resolution displays.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Bluetooth & devices › Mouse › Additional mouse settings › Pointer Options › Enhance pointer precision

name: Disable NCSI Active Internet Probing
description: Stops Windows from sending a test request to Microsoft's connectivity server when a network connects. Windows may then show 'No Internet' even when online.
warnings: May cause Windows to report 'No Internet' or break captive portal detection on Wi-Fi networks.
whatItDoes: Disables NCSI active internet probing to Microsoft servers.
sideEffects: Network status icon in the system tray may erroneously show 'No Internet Access' even when connectivity works.
effectNote: Takes effect the next time a network connects; restart the PC if the status does not change.

name: Restrict Delivery Optimization to Local Network Only
description: Stops Windows Update from uploading update packages to random computers across the public Internet.
whatItDoes: Restricts Windows Update peering strictly to local subnet peers (DODownloadMode = 1).
sideEffects: Prevents Windows Update from downloading or uploading update bits to computers outside your local area network.
effectNote: Local-network-only peering is already the default. This only changes something if 'Devices on my local network and the Internet' was turned on.

name: Enable DNS over HTTPS (DoH) System Fallback
description: Configures Windows DNS client to prefer secure encrypted DNS over HTTPS queries when supported by resolver.
whatItDoes: Configures DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) encryption for DNS client queries.
sideEffects: DNS queries are encrypted; local network DNS filtering or captive portals may fail if DoH cannot reach the upstream resolver.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Network & internet › Wi-Fi / Ethernet › DNS server assignment › Encrypted only (DNS over HTTPS)
effectNote: DoH is used only when your DNS server supports it (for example Cloudflare, Google or Quad9). With your router or ISP DNS this changes nothing.

name: Disable Teredo IPv6 Tunneling
description: Disables obsolete Teredo transition protocol tunneling to reduce attack surface and prevent IP leaks.
whatItDoes: Disables Teredo IPv6-over-IPv4 tunneling transition technology.
sideEffects: Prevents Teredo tunneling; applications or multiplayer games requiring Teredo NAT traversal may lose connectivity.

name: Disable Transparency Effects
description: Turns off transparency on taskbar, Start menu, and windows to reduce GPU overhead.
whatItDoes: Disables acrylic transparency effects across Windows taskbar and application windows.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Accessibility › Visual effects › Transparency effects

name: Disable Window Minimize/Maximize Animations
description: Speeds up desktop responsiveness by eliminating window transition animations.

apply.script:
$v = [int](Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics').MinAnimate
Add-Type -Namespace WinVelo -Name AnimSpi -MemberDefinition '[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct ANIMATIONINFO { public uint cbSize; public int iMinAnimate; } [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(uint uiAction, uint uiParam, ref ANIMATIONINFO pvParam, uint fWinIni);'
$ai = New-Object WinVelo.AnimSpi+ANIMATIONINFO
$ai.cbSize = 8
$ai.iMinAnimate = $v
[WinVelo.AnimSpi]::SystemParametersInfo(0x49, 8, [ref]$ai, 3) | Out-Null

undo.script:
$v = [int](Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics').MinAnimate
Add-Type -Namespace WinVelo -Name AnimSpi -MemberDefinition '[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct ANIMATIONINFO { public uint cbSize; public int iMinAnimate; } [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(uint uiAction, uint uiParam, ref ANIMATIONINFO pvParam, uint fWinIni);'
$ai = New-Object WinVelo.AnimSpi+ANIMATIONINFO
$ai.cbSize = 8
$ai.iMinAnimate = $v
[WinVelo.AnimSpi]::SystemParametersInfo(0x49, 8, [ref]$ai, 3) | Out-Null

whatItDoes: Disables window minimize, maximize, and control animations.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Control Panel › System › Advanced system settings › Performance › Animate windows when minimizing and maximizing

name: Enable Storage Sense Auto-Cleanup
description: Automatically frees up disk space by deleting old temp files and recycled items.
whatItDoes: Enables automated Windows Storage Sense to clean temporary files and empty Recycle Bin.
sideEffects: Windows deletes unused temporary app files and old Recycle Bin items automatically. With default settings it runs only when disk space is low.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › System › Storage › Storage Sense

name: Disable Delivery Optimization Peer-to-Peer (HTTP Only)
description: Disables peer-to-peer distribution of Windows updates, downloading updates directly from Microsoft servers only.
whatItDoes: Configures Delivery Optimization to simple HTTP download mode without peer sharing.
sideEffects: Updates will download solely from Microsoft servers; will not share bandwidth with other PCs on the local network.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Windows Update › Advanced options › Delivery Optimization › Allow downloads from other PCs

name: Disable Automatic Maintenance Wake-Up Timers
description: Prevents Windows Automatic Maintenance from waking the PC from sleep during the night.
whatItDoes: Prevents Windows automatic maintenance from waking the computer from sleep.
sideEffects: Scheduled system maintenance and disk scans will only execute while the computer is already awake and idle.

name: Prevent Search Indexing While on Battery Power
description: Pauses Windows Search background indexing while running on laptop battery to prolong battery life.
whatItDoes: Sets the PreventIndexOnBattery policy so the Windows Search indexer pauses while the PC runs on battery.
sideEffects: Newly created or modified files will not be indexed into search results until the laptop is connected to AC power.

name: Disable NTFS Last Access Time Updates
description: Stops updating file timestamp metadata every time a file is read, reducing unnecessary disk I/O operations.
whatItDoes: Disables NTFS last access timestamp updates on files and directories.
sideEffects: File access timestamps will not be updated when files are read; backup tools relying on last-access times may need configuration.

name: Disable 8.3 Short File Name Creation
description: Disables legacy MS-DOS short file name generation to speed up directory enumeration and file creation.
whatItDoes: Disables legacy 8.3 short filename generation on NTFS volumes.
sideEffects: Older 16-bit or legacy 32-bit software that relies on 8.3 short filename paths may fail to open files.

name: Diagnostic Data Level
description: Reduces diagnostic data sent to Microsoft to the lowest allowed level.
effectNote: On Windows Enterprise and Education, this sets data collection to 0 (Security). On Windows Home and Pro, Windows treats 0 as 1 (Required diagnostic data).
warnings: Windows Settings will display 'Some settings are managed by your organization'. This is normal when Group Policy registry keys are set.
whatItDoes: Sets diagnostic data collection to the minimum required level (AllowTelemetry = 0).
sideEffects: Reduces telemetry reported to Microsoft; diagnostic insights in Feedback Hub and Windows Insider may be limited.

name: Disable Advertising ID
description: Prevents apps from using the advertising ID for relevant ads across experiences.
whatItDoes: Disables the unique advertising ID used for cross-app advertising tracking.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › General › Let apps show me personalized ads by using my advertising ID

name: Disable Tailored Experiences
description: Stops Windows from offering personalized tips, ads, and recommendations based on diagnostic data.
whatItDoes: Disables tailored experiences, diagnostic-based tips, and personalized recommendations.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Diagnostics & feedback › Tailored experiences

name: Disable Online Speech Recognition
description: Disables cloud-based speech services, keeping dictation and speech processing offline.
whatItDoes: Turns off online speech recognition, the same as the switch in Settings > Privacy & security > Speech.
sideEffects: Voice typing (Win+H) and other cloud speech features stop working. Offline features such as Voice access keep working.
sourceQuote: eate a REG_DWORD registry setting named HasAccepted in HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Speech_OneCore\Settings\OnlineSpeechPri

name: Disable Inking & Typing Data Collection
description: Stops sending typing and handwriting sample data to Microsoft for dictionary improvements.
whatItDoes: Sets RestrictImplicitInkCollection and RestrictImplicitTextCollection to 1 to stop local inking and typing personalization, and sets Enabled to 0 to stop sending inking and typing data to Microsoft.
sideEffects: Handwriting recognition and touch keyboard text prediction will not learn your personal vocabulary or custom names.
sourceQuote: ization to a value of 1 (one) -and- Set RestrictImplicitInkCollection registry REG_DWORD setting in HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\InputPersona

name: Disable App Launch Tracking
description: Prevents Windows from tracking app launches to improve Start menu and search results.
whatItDoes: Disables application launch tracking used to personalize Start menu and search results.
sideEffects: Start menu will not track frequently used applications to personalize the top apps list.
sourceQuote: eate a REG_DWORD registry setting named Start_TrackProgs in HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advance

name: Disable Feedback Frequency Prompts
description: Disables periodic popups asking for user feedback about Windows features.
whatItDoes: Sets NumberOfSIUFInPeriod to 0 and the DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications policy to 1 so Windows stops asking for feedback.
sideEffects: Windows will not display prompts asking for user ratings or feedback about features.
sourceQuote: RENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules\NumberOfSIUFInPeriod Based on these settings: Setting PeriodInNanoSeconds NumberOfSIUFInPeriod Autom

name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
description: Disables automatic sending of crash dumps and error logs to Microsoft.
whatItDoes: Disables Windows Error Reporting (WER) automated crash dump collection and uploading.
sideEffects: Application crash reports will not be sent to Microsoft or software vendors for diagnosis.

name: Disable Cloud Clipboard Sync
description: Stops clipboard content from synchronizing across multiple Windows devices.
whatItDoes: Disables cloud clipboard synchronization across signed-in Windows devices.
sideEffects: Copied clipboard text and images will not sync to your other Windows devices.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › System › Clipboard › Clipboard history across your devices

name: Disable Device Search History
description: Prevents Windows Search from saving local device search history.
whatItDoes: Disables local device search history collection.
sideEffects: Search box will not remember or suggest previously entered search queries on this PC.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Search permissions › History

name: Disable Lock Screen Tips & Spotlight Ads
description: Removes suggestions, tips, and promotional overlays from the Windows lock screen.
whatItDoes: Sets RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled and SubscribedContent-338387Enabled to 0 to turn off lock screen fun facts, tips and suggestions.
sideEffects: Spotlight pictures can still rotate, but tip and ad overlays are removed from the lock screen.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Lock screen › Get fun facts, tips, tricks, and more on your lock screen

name: Disable Start Menu Suggested App Ads
description: Prevents Windows from displaying recommended app store suggestions in the Start menu.
whatItDoes: Sets SubscribedContent-338388Enabled to 0 (Windows 10 Start suggestions) and Start_IrisRecommendations to 0 (Windows 11 Start recommendations for tips and new apps).
sideEffects: Promoted third-party apps will not be recommended in the Start Menu.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Start › Show recommendations for tips, shortcuts, new apps, and more
effectNote: On Windows 11 the Start_IrisRecommendations toggle only exists on newer builds (23H2/24H2).

name: Disable System Location Sensor
description: Disables hardware and software geolocation sensor overrides to prevent physical tracking.
warnings: Disables location sensor for apps like Maps, Weather, and Time Zone sync.
whatItDoes: Turns off the device-wide Location services switch (Value set to Deny) and sets SensorPermissionState to 0.
sideEffects: Apps and Windows features such as Maps, Weather, Find my device and automatic time zone cannot get your location.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Location › Location services

name: Deny Apps Access to Location
description: Sets default capability store permission to deny apps access to user physical location.
whatItDoes: Turns off 'Let apps access your location' for Store apps for the current user.
sideEffects: Store apps such as Maps and Weather cannot get your location. Classic desktop apps are not affected.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Location › Let apps access your location

name: Deny Store Apps Access to Microphone
description: Restricts UWP Store apps from silently listening to or accessing audio recording hardware.
whatItDoes: Denies default application access to system microphone devices.
sideEffects: Store apps such as Voice Recorder and Camera cannot record audio. Classic desktop apps are not affected.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone › Let apps access your microphone

name: Deny Store Apps Access to Camera
description: Blocks Store apps from using connected cameras.
whatItDoes: Denies default application access to camera and webcam hardware.
sideEffects: Store apps such as the Camera app cannot use the webcam. Classic desktop apps are not affected.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Camera › Let apps access your camera

name: Deny Apps Access to Read Your Notifications
description: Blocks applications from intercepting or reading private notification listener messages.
whatItDoes: Turns off 'Let apps access your notifications' so Store apps cannot read your notifications.
sideEffects: Apps that mirror notifications (Phone Link, smartwatch companions) cannot read them. Apps can still show their own notifications.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Notifications › Let apps access your notifications

name: Deny Apps Access to Account Information
description: Prevents installed apps from accessing user display name, picture, and account identifier.
whatItDoes: Denies application permission to access user account name and profile picture.
sideEffects: Apps cannot query Windows user account information.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Account info › Let apps access your account info

name: Deny Apps Access to Contacts List
description: Blocks store and system applications from scraping address book contacts.
whatItDoes: Denies application permission to access Windows Contacts and address book.
sideEffects: Apps cannot read your local Windows contacts list.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Contacts › Let apps access your contacts

name: Deny Apps Access to User Calendar & Appointments
description: Prevents third-party apps from harvesting schedule and appointment calendar entries.
whatItDoes: Denies application permission to access Windows Calendar appointments.
sideEffects: Apps cannot read or add appointments to your Windows calendar.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Calendar › Let apps access your calendar

name: Deny Apps Access to Other Apps Diagnostic Info
description: Blocks third-party apps from querying memory and diagnostic stats of other running software.
whatItDoes: Denies application permission to query diagnostic information from other apps.
sideEffects: Apps cannot inspect diagnostic data from third-party applications.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › App diagnostics › Let apps access diagnostic info about other apps

name: Disable Remote Assistance
description: Disables Windows Remote Assistance (Easy Connect and invitation files) to close unsolicited remote help access.
whatItDoes: Disables Windows Remote Assistance (fAllowToGetHelp = 0).
sideEffects: Support technicians cannot connect to this computer using the built-in Windows Remote Assistance helper.
uiEquivalentLocation: Control Panel › System › Remote settings › Allow Remote Assistance connections to this computer

name: Disable AutoRun & AutoPlay on All Drives
description: Prevents malicious executables on USB drives and external media from executing automatically.
whatItDoes: Sets NoDriveTypeAutoRun to 255 to turn off AutoRun and AutoPlay on all drive types.
sideEffects: Removable drives and CDs will not automatically launch executable media installers upon insertion.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Bluetooth & devices › AutoPlay

name: Disable Windows Script Host (VBS/JS Scripts)
description: Blocks execution of standalone .vbs and .js scripts, preventing common malware vectors.
warnings: Can break software installers and administrative scripts relying on VBScript or JScript.
whatItDoes: Disables Windows Script Host (WSH) execution for .vbs and .js scripts.
sideEffects: Legacy VBScript and JScript administrative scripts will be blocked from executing.

name: Enforce Windows SmartScreen via Policy
description: Enforces Windows Defender SmartScreen protection across the operating system via policy.
warnings: This setting is enforced by policy and locks the SmartScreen toggle in Windows Security settings.
whatItDoes: Turns on SmartScreen checks for downloaded apps and files opened from File Explorer (EnableSmartScreen = 1) and locks the setting.
sideEffects: Unrecognized downloaded programs show a SmartScreen warning before they run. Microsoft Edge SmartScreen is not changed.

name: Disable Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution (LLMNR)
description: Disables LLMNR on local networks to eliminate hash-stealing and man-in-the-middle poison attacks.
whatItDoes: Disables Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution (LLMNR) on the local network.
sideEffects: Prevents LLMNR broadcast name resolution; legacy systems on the local network without DNS may fail to resolve hostnames.

name: Disable Remote Desktop Inbound Connections
description: Disables incoming Remote Desktop connections on port 3389.
warnings: Remote Desktop to this PC will stop working.
whatItDoes: Sets fDenyTSConnections to 1 so this PC rejects incoming Remote Desktop connections.
sideEffects: Inbound Remote Desktop connections to this computer will be rejected.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › System › Remote Desktop
effectNote: Windows Home cannot accept Remote Desktop connections, so this has no effect there.

name: Disable Camera Access on Lock Screen
description: Removes the camera shortcut from the lock screen on devices that show it.
whatItDoes: Disables camera access from the Windows lock screen without signing in.
sideEffects: Camera app shortcut will not appear on the lock screen while the device is locked.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options › Dynamic lock
effectNote: The lock screen camera shortcut appears mainly on tablets and 2-in-1 devices; on most PCs this changes nothing visible.

name: Restore Classic Right-Click Menu
description: Restores the Windows 10 full context menu in Windows 11 File Explorer without 'Show more options'.
whatItDoes: Restores classic Windows 10 full context menu in Windows 11 File Explorer.
sideEffects: None known.

name: Always Show Known File Extensions
description: Displays file extensions (.exe, .txt, .pdf) in File Explorer for transparency and security.
whatItDoes: Configures File Explorer to show extensions for all file types.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › View › Show › File name extensions

name: Show Hidden Files and Folders
description: Makes hidden files and folders visible in Windows File Explorer.
whatItDoes: Configures File Explorer to show hidden files and folders.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › View › Show › Hidden items

name: Open File Explorer to This PC
description: Configures File Explorer to launch into 'This PC' view instead of Quick Access / Home.
whatItDoes: Sets File Explorer to open to 'This PC' instead of 'Home'.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › Options › General › Open File Explorer to: This PC

name: Enable 'End Task' in Taskbar Context Menu
description: Adds an 'End Task' option when right-clicking running applications in the taskbar.
whatItDoes: Adds 'End Task' directly to the right-click menu on taskbar application icons.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › System › For developers › End Task

name: Show Seconds in Taskbar Clock
description: Enables seconds display in the Windows system tray clock.
whatItDoes: Displays seconds on the taskbar system tray clock.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar behaviors › Show seconds in system tray clock
effectNote: Not supported on Windows 11 21H2 (build 22000) or early 22H2 builds.

name: Enable Win32 Long Paths (>260 Chars)
description: Lets apps that support long paths use paths longer than 260 characters.
whatItDoes: Sets LongPathsEnabled so apps that opt in to long path support can open paths longer than 260 characters.
sideEffects: Only apps built for long paths benefit; File Explorer and older apps still use the old limit. Restart open apps to apply it.
sourceQuote: EM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem LongPathsEnabled (Type: REG_DWORD) must exist and be set to 1 . The registry value will be cache

name: Align Taskbar Icons to the Left
description: Moves Windows 11 taskbar icons to the left side like Windows 10.
whatItDoes: Aligns Windows 11 taskbar icons to the left.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar behaviors › Taskbar alignment

name: Hide Gallery from File Explorer Navigation Pane
description: Removes the redundant 'Gallery' icon from the left navigation tree in Windows 11 File Explorer.
whatItDoes: Hides the Gallery icon and entry from the File Explorer sidebar navigation.
sideEffects: None known.

name: Hide Recent Files in File Explorer Home
description: Prevents recently opened files from cluttering the Quick Access and Home page.
whatItDoes: Hides recent files from Quick Access / Home in File Explorer.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › Options › General › Privacy › Show recently used files

name: Hide Frequently Used Folders in Quick Access
description: Stops Windows from automatically pinning frequently visited directories in File Explorer.
whatItDoes: Hides frequently used folders from Quick Access / Home in File Explorer.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › Options › General › Privacy › Show frequently used folders

name: Display Full Folder Path in File Explorer Title Bar
description: Shows the complete directory path in the Explorer title bar for precise file navigation.
whatItDoes: Sets FullPath so File Explorer shows the full folder path in the title bar (Windows 10) or in the tab name (Windows 11).
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › Options › View › Display the full path in the title bar

name: Disable Search Box Highlights & Illustrations
description: Removes daily Bing illustrations and web trending topics from the taskbar search box.
whatItDoes: Sets IsDynamicSearchBoxEnabled so search highlights and daily illustrations are turned off in Windows search.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Privacy & security › Search permissions › More settings › Show search highlights

name: Disable Widgets and Weather Icon on Taskbar
description: Turns off Windows 11 Widgets, which removes the weather / MSN feed button from the taskbar.
whatItDoes: Sets the policy AllowNewsAndInterests so Widgets are turned off and the taskbar button is removed.
sideEffects: The Widgets board cannot be opened and the taskbar toggle is locked in Settings.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar items › Widgets

name: Hide Microsoft Teams Chat Icon on Taskbar
description: Removes the integrated personal Teams Chat icon from the Windows taskbar.
whatItDoes: Hides the Microsoft Teams Chat button from the Windows 11 taskbar.
sideEffects: Removes the Teams Chat icon from the taskbar.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar items › Chat
effectNote: Only Windows 11 21H2 and 22H2 have the Chat icon. Newer versions removed it.

name: Hide Task View Button from Taskbar
description: Removes the virtual desktop / Task View button from the Windows taskbar.
whatItDoes: Hides the Task View button from the taskbar on Windows 10 and 11.
sideEffects: Removes the Task View icon from the taskbar; virtual desktops can still be switched using Win+Tab.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar items › Task view

name: Disable Windows Welcome Experience After Updates
description: Stops Windows from presenting full-screen 'What's new' setup and promo screens after feature updates.
whatItDoes: Disables the Windows Welcome Experience post-update configuration screen.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › System › Notifications › Additional settings › Show the Windows welcome experience after updates

name: Disable Tips, Tricks, and Suggestions About Windows
description: Prevents Windows from generating informational popups and suggestions during normal desktop usage.
whatItDoes: Disables tips, tricks, and feature suggestions in Windows notifications.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › System › Notifications › Additional settings › Get tips and suggestions when using Windows

name: Hide Fast User Switching Option
description: Hides the Fast User Switching button from the Start menu and logon screen to avoid leaving background sessions open.
whatItDoes: Hides the Fast User Switching button from the sign-in screen and Start menu.
sideEffects: Users must sign out completely before another user can log into the computer.

name: Exclude Hardware Drivers from Windows Update
description: Prevents Windows Update from automatically replacing your dedicated GPU or chipset drivers.
whatItDoes: Excludes hardware driver updates from standard Windows Update scans.
sideEffects: Windows Update will not update GPU, chipset, or peripheral drivers; drivers must be updated manually.

name: Prevent Forced Auto-Reboot While Logged On
description: Stops Windows Update from forcibly restarting your PC when updates install while you are logged in.
whatItDoes: Prevents Windows Update from automatically rebooting the computer while a user is logged on.
sideEffects: System reboots for completed updates will wait until the user explicitly initiates a restart or signs out.

name: Notify Before Downloading Windows Updates
description: Configures Automatic Updates to AUOptions 2 (notify before downloading) to prevent unexpected bandwidth spikes.
warnings: Requires manual confirmation to download and install updates.
whatItDoes: Sets Automatic Updates to notify before downloading and installing updates (AUOptions = 2).
sideEffects: Windows will notify you when updates are available rather than automatically downloading them in the background.

name: Block Windows Update Downloads on Metered Connections
description: Makes sure Windows Update does not download updates automatically on metered networks or hotspots.
whatItDoes: Sets the policy AllowAutoWindowsUpdateDownloadOverMeteredNetwork so updates are not downloaded automatically on metered connections.
sideEffects: Updates wait until you are on an unmetered network. This matches the Windows default but locks the setting.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Windows Update › Advanced options › Download updates over metered connections

name: Enforce Active Hours Policy Against Mid-Day Restarts
description: Enforces smart active hours window (8 AM to 10 PM) so automatic restarts never interrupt daily activities.
whatItDoes: Sets SetActiveHours with ActiveHoursStart 8 and ActiveHoursEnd 22, so automatic update restarts are avoided between 8 and 22.
sideEffects: Windows Update will refrain from restarting the computer during the specified working hours.
sourceQuote: ies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate use SetActiveHours to enable or disable active hours and ActiveHoursStart and ActiveHoursEnd to sp

name: Disable Optional Preview Updates & Beta Rollouts
description: Keeps Windows from automatically receiving optional preview updates (already the default).
whatItDoes: Disables automatic installation of preview and optional non-security update content.
sideEffects: Optional preview updates are not installed automatically; you can still install them by hand from Windows Update.

name: Taskbar Click Opens Last Active Window
description: Clicking a grouped taskbar app switches straight to its last used window instead of showing thumbnails.
whatItDoes: When an app has several windows open, a single click on its taskbar icon brings back the window you used last (LastActiveClick).
sideEffects: You no longer see the thumbnail preview list on click; hover still shows previews. File Explorer restarts to apply it.

name: File Explorer Sync Provider Ads - Disable
description: Stops File Explorer from showing OneDrive and Microsoft 365 promotions at the top of the window.
whatItDoes: Turns off sync provider notifications in File Explorer (ShowSyncProviderNotifications), which Microsoft uses to show OneDrive and Office subscription banners.
sideEffects: Sync provider tips and notices no longer appear in File Explorer. File sync itself keeps working.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › Options › View › Show sync provider notifications

name: OneDrive in File Explorer Navigation Pane - Hide
description: Removes the OneDrive entry from the left pane of File Explorer for the current user.
whatItDoes: Hides the OneDrive folder from the File Explorer navigation pane (System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree). OneDrive is not uninstalled.
sideEffects: You reach your OneDrive files through the user folder or the OneDrive tray icon instead. A OneDrive update can add the entry back.

name: Paint AI Features - Disable
description: Turns off Cocreator, Generative Fill and Image Creator in the Paint app.
whatItDoes: Sets the Paint policies DisableCocreator, DisableGenerativeFill and DisableImageCreator so these AI tools are removed from Paint.
sideEffects: The AI buttons disappear from Paint after it is reopened. Regular drawing and editing are unchanged.

name: Notepad AI Features - Disable
description: Turns off Copilot, Rewrite and Summarize features in Notepad.
whatItDoes: Sets the Notepad policy DisableAIFeatures so the AI writing tools are removed from Notepad.
sideEffects: Notepad keeps working as a plain text editor without the AI menu. Reopen Notepad to see the change.

name: Click to Do - Disable
description: Turns off Click to Do, the AI overlay that suggests actions for text and images on screen.
warnings: Windows Settings will display 'Some settings are managed by your organization'. This is normal when Group Policy registry keys are set.
whatItDoes: Sets the Windows AI policy DisableClickToDo so the Click to Do component and its entry points are unavailable.
sideEffects: Click to Do no longer opens from its shortcut or the Snipping Tool. Only affects Copilot+ PCs that have the feature.
sourceQuote: When the policy is enabled, the Click to Do component and entry points won't be available to users.
effectNote: Only has an effect on Copilot+ PCs that include Click to Do.

name: Recall Feature - Make Unavailable
description: Prevents Recall from being turned on, so Windows does not save snapshots of your screen.
warnings: Windows Settings will display 'Some settings are managed by your organization'. This is normal when Group Policy registry keys are set.
whatItDoes: Sets the Windows AI policy AllowRecallEnablement so the Recall optional component cannot be enabled by users on this PC.
sideEffects: Recall and its saved snapshots become unavailable after a restart. To use Recall again, undo the tweak and restart.
sourceQuote: This policy setting allows you to determine whether the Recall optional component is available for end users to enable on their device.
effectNote: Only has an effect on Copilot+ PCs that include Recall.

name: Microsoft Edge Sidebar - Disable
description: Removes the Edge sidebar, including the Copilot button and app panel.
warnings: Edge will show 'Your browser is managed by your organization' in its menu and settings. This is normal when Edge policies are set.
whatItDoes: Sets the Edge policy HubsSidebarEnabled so the sidebar is never shown in Microsoft Edge.
sideEffects: The sidebar and its Copilot entry disappear from Edge. Edge shows that it is managed by your organization.
sourceQuote: If you disable this policy, the Sidebar is never shown.

name: Microsoft Edge Startup Boost - Disable
description: Stops Edge from preloading in the background when you sign in to Windows.
warnings: Edge will show 'Your browser is managed by your organization' in its menu and settings. This is normal when Edge policies are set.
whatItDoes: Sets the Edge policy StartupBoostEnabled so Edge no longer starts its processes early at sign-in.
sideEffects: The first Edge window may open a little slower. Edge shows that it is managed by your organization.
sourceQuote: If you disable this policy, startup boost is turned off.

name: Microsoft Edge Background Apps - Disable
description: Stops Edge from keeping running after you close all its windows.
warnings: Edge will show 'Your browser is managed by your organization' in its menu and settings. This is normal when Edge policies are set.
whatItDoes: Sets the Edge policy BackgroundModeEnabled so Edge fully exits when its last window is closed.
sideEffects: Edge extensions and web apps stop running while Edge is closed, so their notifications pause. Edge shows that it is managed by your organization.
sourceQuote: If you disable this policy, background mode is turned off.

name: Find My Device - Disable
description: Turns off Find My Device so this PC does not report its location to your Microsoft account.
warnings: Windows Settings will display 'Some settings are managed by your organization'. This is normal when Group Policy registry keys are set.
whatItDoes: Sets the policy AllowFindMyDevice so Find My Device is off and locked in Settings.
sideEffects: You cannot locate or remotely lock this PC from account.microsoft.com if it is lost or stolen.

name: Fast Startup - Disable
description: Makes Shut Down perform a full shutdown instead of a partial hibernation of the system.
whatItDoes: Turns off Fast Startup (HiberbootEnabled), so every shutdown fully closes the Windows kernel and drivers.
sideEffects: Cold boots can take a few seconds longer. Helps with dual-boot setups, driver updates that need a clean start, and machines that misbehave after shutdown.
uiEquivalentLocation: Control Panel › Power Options › Choose what the power buttons do › Turn on fast startup

name: Startup Apps Delay - Remove
description: Starts your startup apps right after sign-in instead of waiting a few seconds.
whatItDoes: Removes the short delay Windows adds before launching startup apps (StartupDelayInMSec).
sideEffects: Startup apps compete with the desktop for disk and CPU right after sign-in, so the desktop can feel slower at first on older drives. Benefit is mostly felt on fast SSDs.

name: Close Apps Automatically at Shutdown
description: Shut down, restart and sign out close running apps instead of waiting on the 'This app is preventing shutdown' screen.
whatItDoes: Tells Windows to end apps that do not close by themselves during shutdown, restart or sign-out (AutoEndTasks).
sideEffects: Unsaved work in apps that are still open is lost at shutdown instead of Windows asking you first.
